name: es-foral-payroll
description: Calculate ordinary 2026 employee wage withholding for Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa and Navarra. Covers administration allocation, gross annual remuneration forecasts, the complete provincial and Navarra percentage tables, qualifying descendants, active disability point reductions, contract minimums, cash and in-kind payment treatment, prospective changes, pension annualisation and local wage-return schedules. Use for retenciones del trabajo, Hacienda Foral, Navarra modelo 715 or 745, provincial modelos 110 or 111, annual 190 and payroll certificates. These methods differ from the State payroll balancing algorithm. Determine the actual payer, work centre, territory, contract, annual forecast and documented family circumstances before choosing a table or calculating withholding.
